description: A learner's command of the ways of reading, writing and reasoning used in academic disciplines and real-world domains, including questioning a text's purpose and bias.
title: Academic and Critical Literacy

description: Anxiety tied to learning and assessment in a subject, such as mathematics anxiety, test anxiety and foreign-language anxiety.
title: Academic Anxiety

description: A learner's perception of their own ability in an academic domain, such as how good they think they are at mathematics or at reading.
title: Academic Self-Concept

description: Whether a learner can perceive and operate the material at all — device, bandwidth, sensory and motor.
title: Access

description: Emotions tied to learning activities and their outcomes, such as enjoyment, boredom, frustration, pride, shame and hope.
title: Achievement Emotions

description: The purposes a learner pursues in achievement settings: to master the material (mastery goals) or to demonstrate competence relative to others (performance goals), each in an approach or avoidance form.
title: Achievement Goal Orientation
